findings.rationale: Sponsor claims Ph. Eur. Chemical Reference Substance (CRS) for Compound Gamma. Lot number CRS-CG-2024-PE-003 is provided. Certificate of analysis (CoA) obtained from EDQM. Overlaid IR spectra of the CRS and drug substance submitted confirming identity. Working standard WS-CG-PE-001 qualified against the Ph. Eur. CRS. Source of standards: European Directorate for the Quality of Medicines (EDQM). Whether the Ph. Eur. CRS is used for content determination (quantitative analysis) or identity testing only is not stated in the submission.
